classes.description: Organization — 组织是 Camstar 建模中用于配置层级管理的核心实体。组织可以嵌套（parentOrganization），形成工厂→部门→车间的层级树。每个组织可独立配置类别映射、编号规则、质量处理策略、审批流程、通知事件、UI 偏好和 Portal 主页。员工角色分配（EmployeeRole）和工厂模型都关联到组织上下文。物理上对应 Organization (CdoId: 1125)。

properties.name: setupAccess
properties.description: 设置权限限制 → SetupAccess

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 是否已冻结（只读）

properties.name: notes
properties.description: 备注信息

properties.name: changeHistory
properties.description: 变更历史记录 → ChangeStatus

properties.name: iconId
properties.description: 关联图标的标识符。

properties.name: name
properties.description: 组织的唯一名称（必填）

properties.name: description
properties.description: 描述说明，默认与名称相同

properties.name: organizationNumber
properties.description: 组织编号标识

properties.name: parentOrganization
properties.description: 上级组织（用于组织层级树）→ Organization

properties.name: userRequiredForEsig
properties.description: 电子签名是否需要用户验证

properties.name: collectESigForAllQualityTxns
properties.description: 是否为所有质量事务收集电子签名

properties.name: smtpTransport
properties.description: SMTP 邮件传输配置

properties.name: portalHomePage
properties.description: Portal 首页定义 → UIVirtualPage

properties.name: printQueue
properties.description: 默认打印队列

properties.name: portalMobileHomePage
properties.description: Portal Mobile 首页定义 → UIVirtualPage

properties.name: portalV8HomePage
properties.description: Portal V8 首页定义 → UIVirtualPage

properties.name: filterTags
properties.description: 分类筛选标签，逗号分隔

classes.description: Category Map — 组织级别的质量类别映射，将质量对象类别（Event/CAR）绑定到负责处理的 Triage Spec、Owner、Role，并可配置审批流程映射。是 Organization 的子实体。物理上对应 CategoryMap (CdoId: 1194)。

properties.name: parent
properties.description: 归属的组织 → Organization

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 物理字段 IsFrozen

properties.name: category
properties.description: 质量对象类别枚举：1=Event, 2=CAR（必填）

properties.name: triageSpec
properties.description: 分流/处理规格 → TriageSpec

properties.name: role
properties.description: 负责处理该类别质量对象的角色 → Role

properties.name: owner
properties.description: 负责处理该类别质量对象的 Owner 员工 → Employee

classes.description: Approval Sheet Map — CategoryMap 的子实体，按 ResolutionAction 绑定 ApprovalSheetTemplate，定义不同审批操作对应的审批模板。物理上对应 ApprovalSheetMap (CdoId: 1215)。

properties.name: parent
properties.description: 归属的类别映射 → CategoryMap

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 物理字段 IsFrozen

properties.name: approvalRequired
properties.description: 是否需要审批

properties.name: resolutionAction
properties.description: 审批解决操作枚举（必填）：1=Close

properties.name: approvalSheetTemplate
properties.description: 审批模板定义 → ApprovalSheetTemplate

classes.description: Numbering Rule Map — 组织级别的编号规则映射，将质量对象类别（Category）与编号规则绑定，定义不同质量事件类型的编号策略。是 Organization 的子实体。物理上对应 NumberingRuleMap (CdoId: 1195)。

properties.name: organization
properties.description: 归属的组织 → Organization

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 物理字段 IsFrozen

properties.name: category
properties.description: 质量对象类别枚举（必填）

properties.name: numberingRule
properties.description: 编号规则定义（必填）→ NumberingRule

classes.description: Event Classification Spec Map — 组织级别的子实体配置，将特定的事件分类（Classification）、子分类（Subclassification）和故障模式组（FailureModeGroup）组合，绑定到 ChecklistTemplate、Owner 和 Role，定义不同事件类型的处理方式和默认责任归属。物理上对应 EventClassificationSpecMap (CdoId: 1007)。

properties.name: checklistTemplate
properties.description: 关联的检查清单模板 → ChecklistTemplate

properties.name: classification
properties.description: 关联的事件分类大类（必填）→ Classification

properties.name: subClassification
properties.description: 物理字段 SubClassificationId → SubClassification

properties.name: failureModeGroup
properties.description: 关联的故障模式分组（必填）→ FailureModeGroup

properties.name: organization
properties.description: 归属的组织 → Organization

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 物理字段 IsFrozen

properties.name: role
properties.description: 负责处理该事件分类的角色 → Role

properties.name: owner
properties.description: 负责处理该事件分类的 Owner 员工 → Owner

properties.name: peDefault
properties.description: 是否为该事件分类的默认配置
